items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: And what this guy named in New York, uh, the trombones. He's an Indian. Big chief.

ctx.x: Nice piano player. When you played with Jelly Roll did you ever make any records with him? No, I didn't.

He didn't make no while I was with him. He had made some before I got with him. But I don't think he made no more after that. Because he died right after I got out of the band, me and Swayze. He didn't live long. But I heard all his records, Dr. Jazz and all that kind of stuff. But I didn't make any with him. He never made any records? The only guy that made records was Tiny Pong, Al Wynn, Jimmy Wade. He was a big chief. And what this guy named in New York, uh, the trombones. He's an Indian. Big chief. Oh, you…
Yeah, Bunk was there that year too. The Bunk sure was.
